Consider the picture above. Which of the following is a unit vector that is parallel to $q+r?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we have to find $q+r.$ According to the triangle law of addition, the resultant $q+r$ goes from the tail of $q$ to the head of $r:$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251721/assets/63a95b27b2255ff8d784c1d0715f4a6bf306fb4652c438288a8c404726bac83c.png)

In $△AHB$, we have $∠AHB={90}^{∘}$, $AH=1.5=\frac{3}{2}$ and $BH=4.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}|q+r| & =AB \\  & =\sqrt{A{H}^{2}+B{H}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{(\frac{3}{2})}^{2}+{4}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{73}}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, the magnitude of $q+r$ is $\frac{\sqrt{73}}{2}.$ Consequently, the unit vector is

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =\frac{1}{|q+r|}\cdot (q+r) \\  & =\frac{2(q+r)}{\sqrt{73}}.\end{aligned}
$$
